capabilities: Extract typed triples from frontmatter, Breadcrumbs-style fields, and wikilinks
Validate vault schema for missing fileClasses, provenance, and broken source links
Build GraphRAG prompts from k-hop subgraphs of typed triples
Export triples as Neo4j Cypher MERGE statements or Dataview query templates
Track competency questions and check whether the schema can answer them
extras: Manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; README lists installation from the community store only as 'when published', so it is currently built from source. Fully local with no network calls or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian links and metadata are untyped, so there is no built-in way to model facts as typed triples with provenance or check a vault against a schema.

relations.evidence: designed to work alongside Dataview, Datacore, Metadata Menu, Juggl, Breadcrumbs, and Infranodus
relations.plugin: Dataview, Datacore, Metadata Menu, Juggl, Breadcrumbs, Infranodus

summary: Knowledge-graph plugin that extracts typed subject-predicate-object triples from notes, with provenance, schema validation, GraphRAG prompts, and competency questions.
